goal: Separate fatal system and disk errors from block validity checks
Stop forcing non-validating storage functions to report runtime failures through validation states
Unblock safer validation interfaces and cleaner library error reporting
agreement: General support for separating runtime errors via explicit return values (optout21, hodlinator, l0rinc)
Approach objection preferring exceptions to avoid IBD slowdowns and chain split risks (purpleKarrot)
Concern that flattening errors into booleans risks treating fatal errors as invalid (alexanderwiederin)
Scope objection that adding a fatal error type broadens kernel maintenance surface (arejula27)
Code review approval after earlier correctness bugs were resolved (optout21)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it cleans up error variants in the public C API for external library consumers
Introduces durable architectural separation of fatal errors at the kernel boundary
Unblocks follow-up kernel validation interface improvements

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because operational disk and system failures can no longer be conflated with block invalidity
Prevents misclassifying fatal runtime errors during block connection and chain activation
Provides cleaner and safer error propagation across core validation functions
